title: Fire Damage Restoration | Gold Water Fire, Phoenix, AZ Metro
description: Smoke and soot remediation, odor control, and structural cleanup after a fire. Gold Water Fire serves the Phoenix, AZ metro area. Call (480) 999-3339.
intro: Smoke and soot remediation, odor control, and structural cleanup after a fire, across the Phoenix, AZ metro area.

photo.alt: Fire damage restoration crew removing smoke-damaged drywall near a soot-covered brick fireplace

cards.heading: Assessment and board-up
cards.body: We assess the extent of fire, smoke, and water damage from firefighting efforts, and secure the property.

cards.heading: Smoke and soot removal
cards.body: Affected surfaces, contents, and structural materials are cleaned or removed.

cards.heading: Odor control
cards.body: Treatment to address smoke odor throughout the affected structure.

sections.heading: From cleanup to rebuild
sections.body: Fire damage often means structural repair, not just cleanup. Our reconstruction team handles framing, drywall, and finish work to bring the property back. One company, start to finish.

faqs.q: Is smoke odor removed along with visible soot?
faqs.a: Yes. Odor treatment is part of the fire damage process, addressing smoke odor throughout the affected structure, not just the visibly burned areas.

faqs.q: Can you also rebuild what was damaged in the fire?
faqs.a: Yes. Gold Water Fire's reconstruction team, led by Construction Manager Brandon Gurr, handles framing, drywall, and finish work after cleanup, so the whole job stays with one company.

faqs.q: What areas do you serve for fire damage restoration?
faqs.a: The greater Phoenix, Arizona metro area, from Peoria and Surprise in the northwest to San Tan Valley and Apache Junction in the southeast, and the cities in between.

cta.heading: Fire damage needs a fast, careful response.
cta.body: Call Gold Water Fire to get a crew assessing the damage.

evidence: Process steps are general restoration-industry practice, not GWF-specific claims. Reconstruction lead attribution (Brandon Gurr) matches confirmed team facts. Service-area line matches Jake's confirmed 2026-08-06 boundary description. No certification, bonding, testimonial, or response-time number stated.
